profile.headline: Software Developer IV @ Navy Federal Credit Union
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
As a Software Developer at Navy Federal Credit Union, I play an instrumental role in driving technological innovation and operational efficiency. I develop advanced features, APIs, and services, specifically tailored to streamline and automate various aspects of mortgage services. Leveraging a versatile tech stack, including React for dynamic front-end interfaces, SQL for robust data management and C#/.NET for back-end development, I have consistently delivered impactful solutions that enhance the overall user experience within the mortgage service domain.

I completed my Master of Science in Computer Science at Arizona State University, where I have gained a solid foundation in various programming languages, frameworks, and tools. I have also honed my skills in graphic design, web development, and data visualization through various projects and internships. For example, I developed new interfaces for the school's website using HTML, CSS and Javascript, and created portals and graphics for event registrations and feedback. I also devised Conditional Formatting v2.0 with customer-awaited features for table widgets at NetApp, using React and Javascript. I am passionate about developing innovative solutions and learning the best technologies.

I am an experienced Software Developer with a passion for developing innovative solutions and possess a diverse range of skills and expertise in ReactJS, Angular, NodeJS, C++, C#, Python, and database languages. I am adept at problem-solving and self-management; keen to learn the best technologies.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked as a full-stack developer on data observability platforms structured with Angular, Typescript, Kotlin, MongoDB and GraphQL. Managed services across multiple clusters, designed UI/UX in Figma and revised functionalities.
- Forged a new product ‘Dashplot’ which is a dynamic dashboard generator used for cloud based products at Acceldata. Dashplot serves as a platform for users to create customized dashboards, write queries to fetch data, creatively visualize it in variety of graphs and charts, import the widgets into dashboards, and arrange them anywhere in the dashboard using drag and drop feature. Received appreciation award from Senior Leadership people for this product.
